versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the room-status-query skill.
- Provides two API endpoints to query current meeting room status: available rooms and recently released rooms.
- Automatically handles common aliases ("八街" to "东方电子科技大厦", "融科" to "融科融智创新园") for user queries.
- Structured output: grouped tables by city and building, with clear display of room info and update time.
- All results include a booking link at the end.
- Only supports room status queries; booking is not available through this skill.
